If an alarm isn\'t dismissed in time, the people you choose get a Telegram message, and another one once it\'s dismissed. Even if no one is at the computer at night, someone at home or a neighbour finds out. The messages are sent by a Telegram bot you create; no other server is involved.
Ask each person to open %s in Telegram and tap Start (you can also add the bot to a family group). Then click Find people.
